description: One-call visibility audit for a public website: Sellular visibility score (0-100, A-F) and whether llms.txt exists (root or .well-known). Reports NO directory coverage, for any domain, including your own: that needs the account's submission records, so ask check_submission_readiness instead. Read-only; results cached 24h per domain. Use when asked to audit or size up a site's overall discoverability in one shot.

domain.description: A domain (example.com) or full URL to scan.
